incident-bot: ALERT P1 — abnormal surge in 5xx and queue latencies for inference endpoints in eu-west-1. error-rate spike detected: +375% over 10m window. Paging oncall.
Eli: I'm live. seeing heavy degradation concentrated on /v1/embeddings and a smaller but noisy signal on /v1/chat/completions with long tail p99. Starting rapid triage. :rotating_light:
Priya: Any sign of a model rollout or config push? Check recent canary traffic and routes.
Eli: No deploys in last 30m. Quick log slice:
```
[eu-west-1] 2378569125 WARN embeddings: request queue 320, dequeue latency rising
[eu-west-1] 2378569128 ERROR runtime: OOM while serving chat -> 502
[eu-west-1] 2378569130 INFO routing: high concurrency from api-key free_zz
```
Nate: Looks like noisy keys and mix of heavy embedding batch sizes. Suggest immediate route specific limits: strongly limit free-tier embeddings, reduce chat max_tokens globally, and flip off rerank for all traffic where used.
Eli: Proposed quick mitigations (minimal blast radius):
- per-key embeddings cap: free_* -> 0.5 rps
- chat global max_tokens -> 800, and soft-concurrency -> 8
- disable rerank route globally for 45 minutes
Priya: Also recommend a protective measure for partners: whitelist paid-tier keys so we don't break SLA customers unintentionally.
Eli: Executing via ops control plane now. Commands:
```
# throttle embeddings for free tier
rwdctl quota update --route /v1/embeddings --match-prefix free_ --rps 0.5 --ttl 2700 --tag incident=2378569123
# reduce chat tokens and concurrency
rwdctl quota update --route /v1/chat/completions --max-tokens 800 --soft-concurrency 8 --ttl 2700 --tag incident=2378569123
# global toggle off for rerank
rwdctl feature set --name rerank --enabled false --reason "incident 2378569123" --ttl 2700
```
ops-bot: Accepted. Applying changes.
ops-bot: Applied throttles: /v1/embeddings free_* -> 0.5 rps. chat max-tokens and soft-concurrency updated. rerank set to disabled. All changes tagged incident=2378569123 and TTL=2700s.
Linh: Can we do per-route model fallback? If embeddings free-tier can map to quant-4b to reduce mem. Also consider moving a slice of chat traffic to a smaller replica pool to reduce OOM risk.
Eli: Yes. I'll add a model mapping and a small canary.
```
# route->model mapping for free embeddings
rwdctl routing map --route /v1/embeddings --match-prefix free_ --model quant-4b --canary 10 --ttl 3600 --tag incident=2378569123
# create small chat fallback pool
rwdctl pool scale --pool chat-fallback --gpus 1 --model small-quant --ttl 3600 --tag incident=2378569123
```
ops-bot: Mapping scheduled, canary sampling started (10 requests). chat-fallback pool creation queued.
Grace: Support here. Which customers got hit hardest so we can notify? We need a minimal customer impact list for SLAs and account teams.
Eli: Top offenders by request volume in last 15m: free_alpha_01, free_zz, partner_beta, enterprise_acme_9. enterprise_acme_9 has some failures but small proportion; offer them exception if they report issues.
Priya: Add temporary exception for enterprise_acme_9 so they get higher embeddings quota while we stabilize.
```
# exception for enterprise
rwdctl quota update --route /v1/embeddings --key enterprise_acme_9 --rps 10 --ttl 7200 --tag incident=2378569123
```
ops-bot: Exception applied for enterprise_acme_9. embeddings 10 rps TTL 7200s.
Nate: Monitoring: after throttles and routing changes — embeddings queue depth down 48%, total 5xx reduced ~30%, chat p95 improved slightly but p99 still high. Keep observing for 20m.
Eli: Handoff: I'm handing incident ops to Priya for monitoring and next steps. Summary for new oncall: enforced per-endpoint per-key throttles for embeddings free tier; reduced chat tokens+concurrency; disabled rerank; model mapping for free embeddings to quant-4b with 10-request canary; created chat-fallback pool. All changes tagged with incident id and TTLs.
Priya: Acknowledged. I'll monitor p95/p99 and check canary quality signals. If we do not see p99 fall within 15m, Plan B: add +2 GPUs to primary pool and further reduce free-tier to 0.25 rps.
Linh: I'll prepare the scale up command and validate boot times.
Eli: Note to self/postmortem: collect noisy-key histogram, evaluate adding automated per-key backpressure earlier in routing, and create a runbook entry for per-route feature toggles and TTL best practices.
ops-bot: 10m metrics update: error-rate -34% vs peak, embeddings queue depth -52%, chat p99 down 18% but still slightly above baseline. System status: degraded -> stabilizing.
Priya: Support will notify affected partners with guidance and temporary exception info. I'll plan controlled re-enable of rerank after p99 < baseline +3% for 45 continuous minutes.
Grace: Thanks team — I logged incident ticket INT-2378569123 and assigned follow-ups: customer outreach, runbook updates, model fallback validation.
Priya: Closing note: mitigations primarily succeeded. We'll keep the model mapping and fallbacks as short-lived mitigations; all TTLs set so configs auto-revert. Oncall owner: Priya. Please add any additional notes to the incident doc. :white_check_mark:
